insuranceTypes.name: Responsabilité Civile (RC)
insuranceTypes.description: Assurance obligatoire couvrant les dommages causés aux tiers lors d'un accident. Cette assurance protège tous les passagers en cas de collision.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Dommages corporels et matériels aux tiers - Plafond : 50 000 000 Ar

insuranceTypes.name: Assurance Tous Risques
insuranceTypes.description: Protection complète couvrant tous les types de dommages, y compris le vol, l'incendie, les catastrophes naturelles et les accidents corporels des passagers.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Dommages au véhicule, vol, incendie, catastrophes naturelles, accidents corporels - Plafond : 100 000 000 Ar

insuranceTypes.name: Assurance Bagages
insuranceTypes.description: Protection de vos bagages contre la perte, le vol ou les dommages pendant le transport. Indemnisation rapide en cas de sinistre.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Perte, vol ou dommages des bagages - Plafond : 500 000 Ar par passager

insuranceTypes.name: Assurance Annulation
insuranceTypes.description: Remboursement de votre billet en cas d'annulation pour motif valable (maladie, urgence familiale, catastrophe naturelle). Souscrivez lors de la réservation.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Remboursement jusqu'à 100% du prix du billet selon le motif

insuranceTypes.name: Civil Liability (RC)
insuranceTypes.description: Mandatory insurance covering damages caused to third parties in an accident. This insurance protects all passengers in case of collision.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Bodily injury and property damage to third parties - Limit: 50,000,000 Ar

insuranceTypes.name: Comprehensive Insurance
insuranceTypes.description: Complete protection covering all types of damage, including theft, fire, natural disasters, and passenger bodily injuries.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Vehicle damage, theft, fire, natural disasters, bodily injuries - Limit: 100,000,000 Ar

insuranceTypes.name: Baggage Insurance
insuranceTypes.description: Protection of your luggage against loss, theft, or damage during transport. Quick compensation in case of claim.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Loss, theft or damage to luggage - Limit: 500,000 Ar per passenger

insuranceTypes.name: Cancellation Insurance
insuranceTypes.description: Reimbursement of your ticket in case of cancellation for valid reasons (illness, family emergency, natural disaster). Subscribe when booking.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Reimbursement up to 100% of ticket price depending on reason

mg.title: Ny fiantohana ho an'ny fiarovana anao

insuranceTypes.name: Andraikitra Sivily (RC)
insuranceTypes.description: Fiantohana tsy maintsy atao manaraka ny fahasimbana ateraky ny hafa amin'ny loza. Ity fiantohana ity dia miaro ny mpandeha rehetra raha misy fifadonana.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Ratra ara-batana sy ara-pitaovana ho an'ny hafa - Fetra: 50 000 000 Ar

insuranceTypes.name: Fiantohana Feno
insuranceTypes.description: Fiarovana feno manaraka ny karazana fahasimbana rehetra, anisan'izany ny halatra, ny afo, ny loza voajanahary ary ny ratra ara-batana ho an'ny mpandeha.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Fahasimban'ny fiara, halatra, afo, loza voajanahary, ratra ara-batana - Fetra: 100 000 000 Ar

insuranceTypes.name: Fiantohana Entana
insuranceTypes.description: Fiarovana ny entanao amin'ny fahaverena, halatra, na fahasimbana mandritra ny fitaterana. Fanonerana haingana raha misy loza.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Fahaverena, halatra na fahasimban'ny entana - Fetra: 500 000 Ar isaky ny mpandeha

insuranceTypes.name: Fiantohana Fanafoanan
insuranceTypes.description: Famerenana ny vidin'ny tapakila raha misy fanafoanan noho ny antony mety (aretina, maika ara-pianakaviana, loza voajanahary). Midira rehefa manao famandrihana.
insuranceTypes.coverage: Famerenana hatramin'ny 100% ny vidin'ny tapakila arakaraka ny antony
